name: What steps are involved in a full interior remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in a full interior remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A whole-home interior remodel typically begins with an initial consultation, followed by layout planning, rough trades, drywall, and finishing touches. Once structural framing, rough plumbing, and electrical coordination are complete, the build moves into drywall hanging, taping, and texturing. After walls are prepped, crews install custom tile, marble, trim, molding, and flooring before applying final paint coats. Managing the remodel with an owner-operated general contractor keeps communication streamlined, as on-site leads oversee structural and finish work while coordinating specialized mechanical sub-trades to keep phases moving in the proper sequence.
acceptedAnswer.description: An interior remodel involves design planning, framing, rough plumbing and electrical, drywall, tile installation, finish carpentry, and final paint.
